p_value, k_value = map(int, input().split())

MODULUS_CONST = 1000000007

if k_value == 0:
    cycle_count = p_value - 1
elif k_value == 1:
    cycle_count = p_value
else:
    cycle_count = 0
    visited = [False] * p_value
    for start in range(1, p_value):
        if not visited[start]:
            visited[start] = True
            cycle_count += 1
            j = (start * k_value) % p_value
            while not visited[j]:
                visited[j] = True
                j = (j * k_value) % p_value

total_product = 1
for _ in range(cycle_count):
    total_product = (total_product * p_value) % MODULUS_CONST

print(total_product)
